clinician.final_diagnosis: DM type 2, hypertension, homozygote HbE and renal complications
clinician.trajectory_summary: A 52-year-old woman with a 10-year history of diabetes and hypertension presented for routine check-up reporting weakness and dizziness. Hemoglobin electrophoresis was performed and showed HbE 89.4%, confirming homozygote HbE. Although renal function tests, urinalysis, and CBC were ordered, their results were not documented in the available source. The working diagnosis was supported by the clinical presentation and confirmed homozygote HbE, with renal complications suspected but not conclusively documented.
